name: Colour Factory
summary: Time Out describes it as a Black-owned club and live music space in Hackney Wick, noted for putting female, non-binary and queer artists on its bills. It sits in Queen's Yard and also has a food court and space for other kinds of events.

music.notes: Time Out highlights low-key weeknight sessions and jams alongside weekend events that sell out.

crowd: Says it champions cultural diversity and aims to be inclusive, with everyone welcome. Nights are aimed at different communities, and the venue may turn away anyone it judges wrong for a given event.

accessibility.notes: The second room is up 15 steps. The garden is step-free as far as the bar but the ground is uneven; temporary ramps on request. The accessible toilet needs a RADAR key (ask staff if you lack one). Disabled visitors can bring a PA or support worker free: email welfare@colourfactory.com.

evidence.quote: We are a nightclub, live music venue, food court and multi-functional events space in hackney wick.
We advocate cultural diversity and offer an all inclusive environment in which everybody is welcome.
Colour Factory is a Black-owned nightclub and live music venue in the heart of Hackney Wick. It’s known for spotlighting female, non-binary, and queer artists
has an excellent programme of low-key nights and jam sessions during the week in addition to their sell-out weekend events
Expect everything from jazz to techno and experimental pop.
Colour Factory is a 1600-capacity venue providing a blank canvas that can be tailored for all manner of events.
Colour Factory host events catering to different communities, and as such, reserve the right to refuse entry if an individual is deemed unsuitable for the event in question.
The 700-cap main room is fully accessible and step-free.
The 300-cap second room is accessible by a 15-step staircase.
The 300-cap outdoor garden space has step-free access until the bar. Please bear in mind the ground can be uneven
If needed, temporary ramps are available upon request.
We also have an accessible toilet located between the garden and main space. To gain access, you must use a RADAR Key
If you do not have one, please alert a member of staff upon arrival.
we run an access scheme that allows people with disabilities and/or long-term medical condition to bring their personal assistant or support worker in for free.
Please email us at welfare@colourfactory.com so that we can make the necessary arrangements.
Late-night events at Colour Factory are +18.
The price is £4 per item when in operation.
